content:
incident-bot: PAGER -> Peregrine Health (prod-vpc)
incident-bot: Alert: NLB target-group (tg-0a1b2c) for model-serving returning 503 / failing health checks. Impact: inference endpoints 502/503. Assigned: @raj-sre

raj-sre: Ack, taking lead. What’s the current blast radius? any dedicated pool or shared?

dave-netops: Seeing NLB health checks from the NLB control plane failing to reach targets. Target IPs (10.x) show SG rejected. No target deregister yet. Recent sg change by `sg-a9b8c` at 2026-03-17T08:12Z (suspected)

maria-eng: Peregrine is on a private VPC with a single dedicated pool (dedicated-prod-12). All model v1 endpoints return 502.

sophia-cs: Customer impact: All production inference requests time out -> app errors. Customer escalated to account team. No billing impact yet but revenue impact potential.

raj-sre: Oncall-rota, handoff to me. I'll test SG rules and NLB probe origin. team-security looped.

team-security: Confirming a recent automated change from config-sync removed `ALLOW:NLB-HEALTHCHECKS` from workers SG due to stricter sg-template. Investigating why.

raj-sre: Temp mitigation plan:
- Add back SG rule to allow NLB healthcheck CIDRs to worker SG
- If that fails, failover DNS to fallback ALB (weight shift 100%)
- Keep customer updated

dave-netops: Running command now:
```
aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-a9b8c --protocol tcp --port 6443 --cidr 10.0.0.0/8
```

raj-sre: I ran `aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids sg-a9b8c` — rule present, re-added. Rechecking targets.

dave-netops: Targets immediately passing health checks again, TG shows healthy count 8/8 :white_check_mark:

raj-sre: Rolling checks on endpoints — first tests show requests succeed. Sophia plz confirm customer side recovery.

sophia-cs: Customer reports reduced errors, app metrics improving. They still see occasional 502s for ~5% of requests.

maria-eng: Let's keep ALB fallback ready. Preparing Route53 JSON for a quick `change-resource-record-sets` to shift traffic.

raj-sre: Noted. For transparency, opening incident ticket: RDW-INC-20260317-115. Postmortem owners: team-security + eng-runtime.

team-security: Root cause likely config-sync rule regression. We'll add guard to prevent sg template from removing NLB healthcheck rule for dedicated pools.

oncall-rota: Nice work. Action items:
- team-security: add guard + revert rule history
- eng-runtime: add synthetic health tests for NLB healthchecks to catch earlier
- cs: update Peregrine with RCA timeline and ETA

raj-sre: Marking incident resolved for paging. Will keep ticket open until RCA and Jira done.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: 503->fixed. Duration ~9m. Created RDW-INC-20260317-115. :tada:
